job_description:
Roberson Design is seeking a motivated individual to manage and grow a flourishing young web department. Work directly with great clients and talented art director. Manage websites and other multimedia projects (CD ROM). Candidates must have at least 3 years of demonstrated web design/development experience, excellent communication and organization skills, and a self-directed and results-oriented mind set. Ideal candidate will also have graphic design skills and a working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, Dreamweaver, Flash, FTP clients, workflow methodology and informational architecture (Mac OS). Competitive salary and benefits. EOE.

Roberson Design is looking for the very best talent in the visual

communication field. If you are a highly motivated and creative

individual we are interested in knowing more about you.

small but very rewarding, diverse, and challenging.
